What we build

Patterns we've shipped
(or could ship for you).

Project-based engagements, scoped after a 30-minute call. Most builds land between $15k and $80k depending on complexity, integrations, and eval needs.

INTERNAL TOOLS

Custom GPTs for your team

Branded assistants trained on your playbooks, brand voice, or proprietary data. Lives in ChatGPT/Claude or embedded in your tools. Saves the same question being answered 50 times a day.

SUPPORT

Customer support agents

Tier-1 deflection that actually works. Trained on your help docs, ticket history, and product. Hands off to a human when it should — and tells you why.

SALES

Sales / RFP assistants

Drafts proposals, fills out vendor questionnaires, and pulls relevant case studies from your library. Sales teams stop dreading paperwork.

OPS

Workflow automations

Multi-step automations that read email, route to the right system, fill out forms, summarize meetings, follow up. The boring jobs no one wants to do twice.

DATA

Document & data extraction

Pulls structured fields from invoices, contracts, claims forms, lab reports — whatever shape your unstructured pile is in. Outputs to your DB or CSV.

RESEARCH

Research & synthesis agents

Long-running agents that gather, compare, and summarize sources — competitor intel, market research, scientific literature, news monitoring. Replaces "someone Googling for an hour."
